summary_text: Upcoming Earnings: Nvidia is set to report its Q1 FY27 earnings results on Wednesday, May 20, 2026. Expected Financial Performance: Nvidia is expected to report Q1 results with EPS and revenues for the period expected to be up +118.5% and +78.7% from the same period last year, respectively. Wall Street expects Nvidia to post earnings of $1.74 per share, a 115% increase YoY. Key Catalysts: Goldman Sachs identifies continued estimate upgrades and valuation multiple expansion as the catalysts for additional gains over the coming year. Nvidia is expected to emphasize its leadership position in providing the most economical inference solutions, supported by its consistent annual product refresh cycle. Important Note: The bar for stock outperformance is relatively high entering the earnings announcement, suggesting that strong execution may already be priced into the stock.
